title: neanotis tubulosa
intro: Neanotis tubulosa, commonly known as the Purple Sundew or Purple Lip Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of fever. The therapeutic actions of Neanotis tubulosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
